# `try_divide`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Returns `dividend`/`divisor`. It always performs floating point division. Its result is always null if `expr2` is 0. `dividend` must be a numeric or an interval. `divisor` must be a numeric.

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 3.5 and later.

## Syntax

```text
try_divide(dividend, divisor)
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `math_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 3.2.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 2 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- try_divide, example 1
> SELECT try_divide(3, 2);
1.5
```

```sql
-- try_divide, example 2
> SELECT try_divide(2L, 2L);
1.0
```

```sql
-- try_divide, example 3
> SELECT try_divide(1, 0);
NULL
```

```sql
-- try_divide, example 4
> SELECT try_divide(interval 2 month, 2);
0-1
```

```sql
-- try_divide, example 5
> SELECT try_divide(interval 2 month, 0);
NULL
```

## Version history

- Added in Spark 3.2.0.
